Delivery speed held up over the past two years (~85-90% of orders arrive within 5 days in a normal month), but it took a real hit during peak season: only 56% of orders arrived within 5 days in the worst week (early December), before recovering within about 2 weeks.
One of our carrier partners, Albion Parcel, broke down starting in November: on-time delivery (within 3 days) fell from 76% in October to 28% in November and December, and hasn't recovered yet.

Which merchant has 'good' or 'bad' delivery isn't really about the merchant or the warehouse - it's almost entirely about which carrier handles their shipments: the exact same merchant sees 89% of parcels arrive within 3 days on one carrier vs. just 19% on another.
